# Welcome to My Data Science Portfolio

Hi! I’m Mitchell Heaton, a Statistics major at Brigham Young University with an emphasis in Data Science.  
This site showcases my projects, learning journey, and examples of my work with real data.

## Purpose of This Blog

I created this blog to share my progress as I explore data analysis, machine learning, and quantitative modeling.  
You can expect project demos, tutorials, and insights into how I apply statistical methods to real-world problems.  
I hope this portfolio gives readers a clear sense of my skills, interests, and approach to solving data challenges.
